title: api/functions
description: Addon API functions present in a client build, from Blizzard_APIDocumentation and the global environment. Files live at data/api/<build>/functions.jsonl.

name.description: Fully qualified, for example C_Container.GetContainerItemInfo or GetItemInfo.

inner_type.description: Element type when type is table (InnerType in Blizzard_APIDocumentation).

mixin.description: Mixin the value is created from, for example ItemLocationMixin.

inner_type.description: Element type when type is table (InnerType in Blizzard_APIDocumentation).

mixin.description: Mixin the value is created from, for example ItemLocationMixin.

documented.description: True if present in Blizzard_APIDocumentation; false if only found in the global environment.

present.description: False when Blizzard_APIDocumentation describes the function but it was not callable in the global environment at login (documented for another flavor, or not implemented in this build). Absent means true.
